subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: After repairing authorization ordering, should plugin-runtime callers be permanently denied patch access to every legacy ownerless session row?
rationale: Ownerless rows have no trustworthy plugin authority, but unconditional denial can stop previously working plugin-runtime patch flows after an upgrade.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Keep legacy ownerless rows operator-only and require plugins to create newly owned session rows.

options.title: Add trusted migration
options.body: Provide an operator-controlled doctor or migration path that assigns ownership before plugin-runtime mutation is permitted.

recommendation.title: Fail closed
recommendation.body: Keep legacy ownerless rows operator-only and require plugins to create newly owned session rows.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history owns the affected session patch accessor, lifecycle integration, and original ownership fence.
